title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

AI is reshaping how legal work gets done, and at Legora we're not just watching that happen. We're building it from the inside.

Our AI Enablement function exists to make sure every team at Legora can build, use, and govern AI well. The function is young, the mandate is broad, and right now it's one person. You'd be joining to own a significant slice of that work: managing engineers, translating business needs into action, and becoming the go-to for anything AI across the organization.

This is a high-ownership generalist seat for someone energized by ambiguity who would rather figure it out and ship than wait for a perfect brief.

 

What You'll Be Doing

We operate across three streams, and you'll own initiatives in all of them, from rough idea to shipped result.

Build

- Coordinate agent and internal tool builds with engineers, keeping projects moving and translating between business needs and technical direction.

Enable

- Run training, workshops, and documentation that help teams adopt AI.

- Build and grow an AI champions program across the org.

- Be the day-to-day support that makes enablement actually land.

Govern

- Draft and operationalize guidelines, access policies, and usage guardrails.

- Put the standards in place that let us move fast safely.

Across all three, you'll act as a connector, building the relationships and touchpoints that make the function visible and trusted.

 

Who You Are

- A few years in a fast-moving environment: ops, strategy, product, consulting, program management, or similar. Shape matters more than title.

- Genuinely AI-native, or clearly on the way: you reach for AI tools by default and want to go deeper.

- True generalist: comfortable switching between strategy, delivery, and people work in the same day.

- Exceptional learning speed: you get to depth on unfamiliar things fast and take feedback in quickly.

- Strong communicator with a low-ego, collaborative style.

- Someone who enjoys being in the office 5 days a week. A key component of Legora's success has been in-person collaboration and we want you to be part of that.

 

Nice To Have

- Technical foundation: engineering degree (or equivalent), with enough coding exposure to hold your own with engineers.

- Exposure to legal, GTM, or a regulated / high-trust environment.

- Experience with agent platforms, workflow tools, or no/low-code AI.

- A track record of starting something from scratch.

 

What Success Looks Like (The First 6 Months)

- You're independently owning initiatives end-to-end across all three streams.

- You've taken real ground on at least one initiative in each

title: Product Owner (Link Key Accounts)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As the Product Owner for Link Key Accounts, you will drive the development and success of our SaaS solutions within the US healthcare ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features, shape prompt design, and ensure our product meets the complex needs of life sciences customers and their key accounts.
What You'll Do

• Own the end-to-end delivery of key product features, partnering closely with data, design, and engineering teams

• Lead the development and launch of AI-powered features, providing thought leadership on prompt design, evaluation, and implementation

• Define and manage technical product requirements, including API specifications and medical claims-based capabilities

• Implement and analyze product usage analytics to understand user journeys, measure success, and improve new-feature adoption

• Engage directly with customers through structured feedback sessions to understand their needs and iterate on newly released features

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager within an established software organization

• 2+ years of experience focused on SaaS products specifically within the US healthcare ecosystem

• A technical degree or equivalent hands-on technical experience

• Proven experience defining and shipping AI/ML-powered product features

Nice to Have

• Experience working with life sciences commercial, market access, or key account management teams

• Based in the UK, Spain, or Germany (preferred locations)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

#RemoteUK
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. •
12+ years in product & tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale

Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor

•
Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust

Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin

Nice-To-Haves

•
Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale

•
Graduate degree in a technical field

•
Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products

Why this role

OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap - on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.

title: Senior Manager, Affirm Bank Operations Enablement
description:
At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.
About The Role
Affirm is building a de novo bank, and this role will help establish and scale its operating foundation. You will own the Finxact core and digital banking experience platforms, lead deposit and lending operations strategy, and partner with servicing teams to build resilient, well-controlled processes that deliver transparent, reliable financial products.
What You’ll Do

• Own the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of Finxact as the Bank’s core system of record, including product structures, rates and fees, transaction and posting rules, account parameters, general-ledger mappings, user entitlements, environments, and controlled production changes.

• Own the operational delivery and ongoing management of Savana and the Bank’s integrated digital account-opening, online and mobile banking experiences. Translate customer and operational needs into requirements; lead user-acceptance testing, release readiness, issue resolution, and continuous platform improvement.

• Lead operational launch readiness, including operating-model design, procedures, roles and responsibilities, staffing and training, end-to-end testing, mock processing days, cutover, go/no-go evidence, hypercare, and the transition to stable business-as-usual operations.

• Direct daily deposit operations, including balancing Federal Reserve activity to the Finxact ledger; reconciling new-account funding; approving outbound ACH and wire files under dual control; managing inclearing, returns, and exceptions; reviewing failed account boarding; monitoring zero-balance account aging; and overseeing dormancy, escheatment, account maintenance, holds, statements, transaction research, error investigations, dispute resolution, regulatory reporting, and fraud-investigation support.

• Direct lending operations by validating underwriting and eligibility results against Bank guidelines; approving or declining funding within delegated authority; creating and approving funding wires with appropriate segregation of duties; validating loan boarding and journal-entry bookings; and reconciling funding, settlement, daily loan activity, and exceptions.

• Oversee loan purchase and sale operations, including seasoning and eligibility validation, loan-tape and documentation quality control, approval and settlement, confirmation of funds received, accurate sold status and sold-date updates, boarding validation, and completion of purchase and sale audits.

• Build and maintain the Bank’s operational control environment in accordance with Bank-approved policies and independent governance. Own documented procedures, maker-checker controls, reconciliations, access reviews, exception aging, quality assurance, records and evidence, root-cause analysis, issue remediation, and audit and examination readiness; partner with Compliance on BSA/AML, OFAC, consumer-protection, privacy, funds-availability, payments, complaint, and other applicable requirements.

• Manage Bank oversight of affiliate-provided services and critical core, digital banking, payments, document, and operations vendors. Maintain Bank decision rights, data ownership, service levels, audit and remediation rights, and escalation paths; monitor performance, capacity, releases, incidents, and control reports; coordinate root-cause review

title: Business & Data Analyst
description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of an acquired screening platform into Veremark . You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.
Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.
You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. It's a hybrid role: half business analysis (processes, requirements, gap analysis), half hands-on data (profiling, reconciliation, reporting). It's a great fit if you've been a BA or data analyst for a few years and want broad exposure to a real M&A integration.
You'll pick up tasks from the Program Director and workstream leads, following our existing M&A integration playbook and flagging anything that doesn't fit.
Platform consolidation

• Help map the acquired platform: check types, workflows, candidate journeys, client configurations and edge cases.

• Carry out gap analysis against Veremark 's product using the playbook templates, and present findings for decision.

• Keep the migration plan and tracker up to date: cohorts, cut-over dates, dependencies and actions.

• Document current and future-state processes, and draft requirements and user stories for review.

Integrations and billing

• Build and maintain the inventory of ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and each client's migration status.

• Help map products, price books and contract terms onto Veremark 's pricing, flagging anything that looks off.

• Support Finance with billing reconciliation through cut-over.

Data, validation and reporting

• Profile the acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, usage by client, active vs. dormant accounts, data quality.

• Help build field-level mappings between the two data models, and test migrated data against them.

• Run the validation and reconciliation queries on each client cohort, and log and chase data issues.

• Maintain the migration dashboard and prepare data for PMO reporting.

• Use AI tools to speed up the work: summarising legacy docs, drafting mappings, cleansing and classifying data.

• Pull usage and revenue data to help the PMO prioritise which clients move first.

Customers and stakeholders

• Provide data and client lists to Customer Success and Sales for migration comms.

• Contribute progress, issues and data to the Program Director's weekly update.

• Follow Compliance guidance on consent, data residency and audit when handling migrated data.

Must have

• 2+ years as a business analyst, business systems analyst or data analyst, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Worked on a platform migration, system implementation or integration project as part of a team.

• Solid SQL (joins, CTEs, aggregations): comfortable writing your own queries to profile and reconcile data.

• Core BA skills: process mapping, gap analysis, data mapping, requirements and user stories, UAT.

• Some experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool (e.g. Looker, Metabase, Power BI).

• Curious about how systems fit together, and confident asking engineers about data models, APIs and integrations.

• Comfortable working to direction and a set playbook, and knowing when to flag an issue rather than guess.

• Meticulous and organised, with a strong eye for detail and data accuracy.

• Clear communicator who can explain data to non-technical people.

Nice to have

• Exposure to pricing, contracts or billing data.

• Experience in background screening, HR tech, RegTech or another regulated industry.

• Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, Bullhorn).

• Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit requirem

Job description Nurturing Home Healthcare is seeking a compassionate and dependable Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) (PRN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes.
The LVN will work under the supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN) and in collaboration with physicians and interdisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver high-quality patient care, promote positive health outcomes, and support patients in maintaining independence in their home environment.
The ideal candidate is clinically competent, organized, and passionate about delivering exceptional care while ensuring compliance with agency policies, physician orders, and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Provide skilled nursing services to home health patients according to physician orders and established care plans. Monitor and assess patient conditions, reporting significant changes to the supervising RN and physician. Administer prescribed medications and treatments safely and accurately. Perform wound care, catheter care, ostomy care, and other skilled nursing procedures as permitted by licensure. Educate patients and caregivers regarding medications, disease management, safety precautions, and treatment plans. Document patient visits, observations, interventions, and outcomes accurately and timely. Assist with the implementation and monitoring of individualized care plans. Collaborate with Registered Nurses, physicians, therapists, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care. Observe infection control practices and maintain patient confidentiality. Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and quality improvement initiatives as needed. Ensure compliance with Medicare guidelines, agency policies, and nursing standards. Support patients and families by providing compassionate care and promoting health, comfort, and independence.
Required Qualifications
Current and active Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) License in the State of Texas. Minimum of one (1) year of nursing experience. Strong clinical assessment and patient care skills. Knowledge of basic nursing procedures and medication administration. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and manage assigned patient visits efficiently. Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and proof of automobile insurance. Current CPR certification or ability to obtain upon hire. Ability to maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation. Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous Home Health experience. Experience working with Medicare patients. Familiarity with home health regulations and documentation requirements. Experience using WellSky (Kinnser) or other electronic medical record systems. Knowledge of chronic disease management and geriatric patient care. Experience with wound care and post-acute care services. Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred. Strong understanding of patient education and caregiver support techniques.
Physical Requirements
Ability to travel regularly between patient homes within the assigned service area. Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, and reach during patient care activities. Ability to lift, transfer, push, or pull up to 50 pounds with appropriate assistance when necessary. Ability to use nursing equipment and perform hands-on patient care procedures. Ability to operate a computer, tablet, and mobile devices for documentation and communication. Visual acuity sufficient to assess patient conditions, administer treatments, and review documentation. Manual dexterity required for medication administration, wound care, and nursing procedures. Ability to work in various home environments and conditions. Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as typing, writing, and documentation throughout the workday.

description:
Company: ISFY (I Sell For You) -
Location: Remote, United States

What you are joining:
ISFY is building the Uber of sales. Our software matches people who want to sell with US brands that need sales. Brands connect their abandoned carts and warm shoppers to our platform, and the platform routes them to independent reps who call, help the shopper and close the sale.

This is an early-stage startup. You will be one of the first reps on a new marketplace for remote selling: you choose your hours, work from home, sell for well-known US brands in e-commerce, skincare and beauty, health and wellbeing, and telehealth, and get paid on every sale you close. Early reps help shape the product and get first access to new brands as we grow.

ISFY helps US ecommerce brands recover sales. Every day, shoppers start an order online, add the product to the cart, and then stop before they pay. Our sales representatives call those shoppers and help them finish the order.

You are not making cold calls. The shopper already chose the product. Your job is to answer their questions, remove the doubt, and close the sale.

What you will do
- Call shoppers who started an online order with one of our US ecommerce brand partners
- Listen, answer questions about the product and the offer, and help the shopper complete the purchase
- Record each call outcome in our system
- Follow our call scripts and our rules on honesty and respect for the customer

What we offer
- Base pay plus commission on every sale you close
- Remote work from anywhere in the United States
- Flexible schedule, agreed with your team leader
- Paid training before your first call, and coaching every week
- A live dashboard where every sale you make shows the same day
- No fees, no leads to buy, and nothing to pay to start

What we look for
- You are based in the United States and authorized to work in the United States
- Clear spoken English
- You are comfortable on the phone and you enjoy talking with people
- Reliable high speed internet and a quiet place to work
- A computer and a headset
- Previous phone sales experience is a plus. We train you.

How to apply
Send an email to with the subject "Remote Phone Sales Representative". Include your name, your city and state, your time zone, and a few lines about your experience on the phone. A short phone interview is the next step.

ISFY Group LLC is a US company and an equal opportunity employer. Details of base pay and commission are discussed during your interview.

title: AI-First Product Manager (Ops Transformation)
description:
About Kompato AI
We’re transforming the debt collection industry with AI-powered automation that delivers compliant, empathetic, and revenue-driving customer experiences. Our mission is to help agencies, lenders, and financial institutions reimagine collections by blending human-level conversation with the efficiency of AI. We’re a fast-growing fintech startup building the operating backbone for modern collections-whether inbound, outbound, or digital self-service.
If you’re energized by stripping down messy, manual processes and rebuilding them as AI-native workflows, and if you can translate operational pain into automation that sticks, this role might be for you.
How you will make an impact in this role
We are looking for our first AI-First Product Manager (Ops Transformation) - a builder who fuses product management rigor with systems-level AI thinking.
Your mandate: take our debt collection operator’s playbook, strip it to the studs, and redesign it for an AI-native organization. That means immersing yourself in daily ops, identifying compliance-heavy bottlenecks, and rethinking how they should work in an AI-first world. You’ll own the journey from raw operator pain → prototype automation → adoption and scaling.
This is a role for someone equally comfortable shadowing frontline staff, drafting RICE + risk-scored automation priorities, and guiding MVP engineering builds (or prototyping in Cursor/Claude code yourself). In short: you’ll turn ambiguity into working automations and repeatable playbooks that compound value across departments.
Responsibilities
Discovery & Translation

• Immerse in daily collections ops to map SOPs and surface pain points.

• Apply Jobs-to-Be-Done and anthropological methods to reframe operator needs.

• Identify and rank-order automation opportunities by reach, impact, compliance risk, and more (RICE + risk-tier).

Design & Execution

• Draft specs and either prototype yourself or manage lightweight engineering builds.

• Ship scrappy MVPs quickly; measure cycle-time, compliance adherence, and throughput.

• Capture learnings in shareable posts, SOPs, and the AI-First Ops Handbook so wins compound.

Governance & Compliance

• Apply strict guardrails: T0-T3 risk tiers, human-in-the-loop where required.

• Define automation governance artifacts (SLAs, SOPs, audit logs).

• Ensure AI workflows are explainable, auditable, and compliant.

Impact & Scaling

• Track adoption: % of ops tasks starting with AI.

• Measure business outcomes: revenue impact, FTE leverage, error reduction.

• Industrialize successful prototypes into repeatable modules.

Requirements
Must have

• 5+ years in product management, ops transformation, or program management.

• Proven track record of translating manual SOPs into automated, governed workflows.

• Experience working in or adjacent to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, collections, gov).

• Familiarity with automation stacks (RPA, workflow orchestration, APIs) and emerging AI architectures (LLMs, agentic systems).

• Data self-service skills (SQL, dashboards) a plus.

• Startup-tested: you can bring order without needing layers of process to get going.

Preferred

• Start with AI: treat automation as the reflexive first step in ops design.

• Human as router: know when to elevate to judgment, compliance, or context.

• Compound wins: document and share so no automation stays siloed.

• Culture builder: normalize AI-first rituals (e.g., “AI Win of the Week”) to drive adoption.

• Execution-first: You thrive in ambiguity, move from pain points to working solutions fast.

• AI-native reflexes: You know LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and agentic orchestration - not just in theory but in how they reshape real workflows.

• Systems thinker: You can zoom out to see the process end-to-end and zoom in to fix the brittle step that breaks it.

• Operator empath: You can shadow a frontline operator and feel where the friction lives.

• Scrappy builder: Bonus if you can prototype

title: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination
description:
Terms of Reference: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination for the Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA)
Background:The Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) is an open energy data partnership between the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), Ember, Global Energy Monitor (GEM), Open Energy Transition (OET), and TransitionZero. Through a shared governance structure and a Secretariat currently housed at GEM, the consortium is working to build an open energy intelligence system based on trusted data, open-source tools, and collaborative analysis.
ORA’s members have already developed the expertise to build every component needed for a shared open data infrastructure as well as reproducible modeling, data pipelines, versioned and citable data, quality metadata, exploration tools, and aggregate data for validation. These components have not yet been coordinated in a cohesive system, and many of the ORA organizations have built similar supporting infrastructure separately. This leaves users and partners to repeatedly reconcile definitions, identifiers, formats, and methodologies, which limits interoperability, auditability, and reuse. The growing use of AI systems for energy questions adds urgency: the standardization, versioning, and source documentation needed to integrate data across ORA are also needed to make open, verified, citable data legible to AI systems.
ORA is entering a 12-month foundational phase to turn the consortium’s vision into an agreed technical and governance blueprint for an open energy data platform and orchestration system, including its audiences, governance, shared standards, and technical architecture for integrating member datasets, open models, and analyses. ORA is committed to ensuring that its core datasets, shared infrastructure, and collaborative tools remain open-source and publicly available.
Objective: ORA seeks an independent consultant, serving as Technical Coordinator, to facilitate and project manage the technical planning of building a shared data infrastructure across the five member organizations. The consultancy includes the interviews and research needed to develop concrete, detailed proposals for how members’ data can be integrated and supports members in agreeing on shared standards, a recommended architecture, and a roadmap for the next phase of the platform and the flagship product, the Open Energy Outlook. The result will be a consortium plan co-authored with the members.
Scope of Work: The Consultant will provide facilitation, project management, and technical analysis for ORA’s defined 12-month foundational planning phase. The Consultant will carry out the following work:

• Facilitation and Consortium Engagement:

• Facilitate the planning process with all five ORA members, preparing agendas and materials, guiding discussions, building consensus among members with different practices and priorities, and documenting decisions and next steps.

• Interview the data leads at each member organization to assess data assets, systems, workflows, and priority user needs.

• Facilitate a shared definition of the platform’s priority users (for example, energy modelers, policy analysts, journalists, civil-society researchers, planners in developing geographies, and AI systems) and the access patterns, tools, and guarantees each needs.

• Lead members through review of, and decisions on, the proposed shared protocols, architecture options, and data hub scope, ensuring all members have meaningful input.

• Project Management:

• Develop and manage an integrated workplan for the foundational phase, with milestones, dependencies, and responsibilities across the five member organizations.

• Track progress, risks, decisions, and action items.

• Coordinate with the ORA Secretariat on communication with members and ORA leads.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.
Our stack is Python ( FastAPI ) on AWS , with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.
Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD .
What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

• Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

• Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

• Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

• Drive the full software development lifecycle , translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

• 5+ years building and operating production backend systems , with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

• Deep fluency in your primary backend language , and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python ; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

• Strong systems fundamentals - concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes - and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

• Sound reasoning under ambiguity : you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

• Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations , including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

• Professional written English , enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

• AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

• Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

• A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:
We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

• 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

• 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.
What We Offer:

• Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

• The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI , tackling hard problems with high ownership.

• A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

description:

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
Who We Are
Every Netflix membership, from the moment someone signs up to every plan change, renewal, and cancellation flows through our platform. The Membership & Monetization Platform (MMP) team owns the commerce backbone of Netflix : the Tier 0 services that manage subscription state, pricing, and plan availability for ~330 million members across 190+ countries, handling millions of requests per second.

title: Senior Director, Talent Acquisition
description:

Job Location: United States, Remote

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

About the role
We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.
What you'll do

• Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.

• Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.

• Define and run a KPI framework (for example time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, quality of hire, hiring manager satisfaction, recruiter productivity). Review it on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.

• Build and apply AI across the recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, outreach, reporting, and recruiter performance insights. Measure the efficiency and quality gains, and retire what does not work.

• Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.

• Manage and optimize agency and vendor relationships: when to use them, how to hold them accountable, and how to reduce reliance over time.

• Act as a trusted advisor to executives, hiring managers, and People leadership. Run intake and workforce planning conversations, push back with data, and keep stakeholders aligned.

• Move between strategy and execution: build the plan in the morning, close the candidate in the afternoon.

• Partner with Finance, People Ops, and Talent Brand on headcount planning, forecasting, employer brand, DEI goals, and candidate experience.

• Build the TA leadership bench: hire, develop, and promote recruiting managers, senior recruiters, and sourcers; define career paths and succession plans.

• Run the team's operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, and regular reporting to the executive team.

• Own the TA budget, including headcount, agency and vendor spend, tools, and job board and event costs. Forecast capacity against the hiring plan and make the case for investment.

• Lead TA technology strategy: ATS configuration, sourcing and scheduling tools, analytics, and vendor selection and renewals.

• Build scalable, consistent hiring practices, including structured interviewing, intake standards, interviewer training, offer approval, and candidate experience.

• Lead through change: reorganizations, hiring surges and freezes, reprioritization, and integration of acquired teams.

What you bring

• 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading TA teams, ideally including a Director-level or higher role.

• Experience in fast-paced, high-growth, or dynamic environments

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.
Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still face many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.
BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.
The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.
We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or a small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.
Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes - calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved - not on how much software they configure themselves.
Our Bloomlex workforce starts with two teammates:
Ava - AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.
Claire - AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.
Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.
They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice - including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles - all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the initial product architecture exists. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder - a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership as the CEO.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with decision collaboration on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
You will inherit working products and live deployments, but you will not inherit sacred architecture. Your job is to determine what should survive, what should be rebuilt, and what needs to exist for BloomLex to scale from pilots to thousands of firms.
Role & Responsibilities

title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

- Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

- Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

- Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

- Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

- Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

- Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

- Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

- Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

- Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

- Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

- Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Role Overview
Lead the architecture, standards, security and performance of an enterprise OutSystems case management platform, including its integration with AI and agentic AI capabilities.
Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for the end-to-end architecture for the platform and ensures the detailed design and development is aligned with the Enterprise Architecture of the organisation.

• Translate business requirements, including application resiliency requirements, into application platform architectural specifications

• Review quality of common services and modules developed by applications and advise on enhancement if needed

• Design the architecture blueprint of the organisation's business, information and ICT assets, by using multiple architectural models.

• Use, govern and enhance the architecture blueprint to ensure that the business and ICT are aligned.

• Define the application platform reference architecture (for OutSystems) and reusable component standards for the case management platform (e.g. Architecture Canvas layering, shared modules and templates), so case management applications are built consistently and reuse common components

• Govern application architecture quality and the integration of applications hosted on the case management platform with the enterprise AI Foundation Platform (currently using Amazon Bedrock) and the shared agentic AI modules, so AI capabilities are embedded into case management workflows

• Define non-functional requirements for the case management platform (performance, scalability, availability, resiliency and security) and verify them through capacity planning, performance and load testing, and tuning, so the platform sustains enterprise-level workloads

• Define the observability architecture for applications hosted on the case management platform and AI agents (logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLIs/SLOs and alerting standards) so platform and agent behaviour can be monitored end to end

• Define the reference architecture for agentic AI on the case management platform, including agent patterns, tool and API integration, agent identity and access, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and where guardrails and controls sit

• Ensure designs comply with IM8 / ICT&SS management policies, and lead the architecture and security submissions (e.g. System Security Plan, Architecture Review Board) for the case management platform and agentic AI changes

• Conduct proactive reviews of platform and application controls at regular intervals against ICT&SS / IM8 requirements and the System Security Plan (SSP), track findings to closure with the DevSecOps and AI engineers, and report control health to the organisation

Requirements

• Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related disciplines

• At least 7 years of relevant work experience, including at least 3 years as a technical lead or system architect (e.g. system design, performance tuning, prototyping and maintenance)

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 full project development life cycles

• Experience in designing and implementing enterprise applications on the OutSystems low-code platform, including reusable modules, integrations and performance tuning. Must possess excellent data modelling and SQL skills.

• Solid understanding of Service Oriented Architectures, web services and APIs, and public web sites / eservices development.

• Experience in server-side .Net and/or Java development is an advantage.

• Solid technical skills and the ability to leverage them to determine the best solution to a technical problem

• Ability to analyse and identify comprehensive solutions considering all functional implications while developing a workable solution

• Results and customer-oriented mindset

• Strong organization and people handling skills

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to pitch ideas and influence stakeholders

• Solid understanding of Gov

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.
